mapper.select: SELECT user_id,password,auth_version,status,email FROM user_info WHERE user_id=#{uid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id,password,auth_version,status,email FROM user_info WHERE email=#{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET password=#{hash},auth_version=COALESCE(auth_version,0)+1 WHERE user_id=#{uid} AND status=1
